objective: On Fi=zi(xiyi+ab) over shared original bits, can the three cyclic parity checks with charges 0,0,1 be canceled by an actual formal degree-two refutation derived from strict 3-CNF? How do grouping, order, representation and size change for growing numbers of checks?
status: Complete: Shared cubic pair checks admit linear checked refutations on their original strict clauses, in any order, although even one unrestricted disjunctive quadratic line cannot report a proper partial sum on the raw bits.
title: Cancel overlapping parity checks from strict clauses
